explication: This repository distributes platform-specific traffic rules and request/response rewrites, alongside standalone automation scripts and external resources. The main user workflow is to choose resources for a supported proxy client, then use rules to classify traffic or rewrites to modify matching traffic; separate scripts capture account credentials, call service APIs, and report results. README capabilities include ad removal, check-ins, account tasks, and other integrations. Sampled source shows several implementations, but does not establish a shared runtime or a central dispatcher.
